digest.component_or_area: snapshot janitor and garbage collection trigger
propositions: Snapshot janitor runs only in the review-bot process, leaving every other host's snapshot store append-only and never reclaimed
Non-review-bot hosts (developer laptops, CI runners, library embeds) populate the snapshot store during gate resolution but have no mechanism to apply the GC policy or reclaim space
The operation-linked GC trigger must avoid long-lock pitfalls by checking freshness O(1) on the operation tail and deferring heavy GC work to a detached child process outside any store lock
A near-free in-process trigger check (one stat of the stamp against the interval cadence) on the tail of gate-resolution calls maybe_gc for attested gates, spawning detached GC only when due

The GC pass runs in a detached child with its own stamped worker-lock and flock sidecars, keyed on the per-host snapshot store root, allowing single-flight coordination across worktrees and harmless degradation when the review-bot resident janitor is also running
The trigger is portable, operation-linked, and in-process — requiring no CI provider, cron, or daemon — while preserving the review-bot's resident janitor as a supplementary cadence
